title: game/data/kitBuilds.json: every kit Billie's recipe, baked into its sheet, rig and native parts by game/js/logic/kit-assemble.js (Studio plan Phase 5, T5.1)

colour.description: a name in colours, a [hue, saturation, value], or null for the kit's own colours

size.description: the part's size against its M picture

x.description: the extra's left: this fraction of the head or torso's width plus this fraction of its own

y.description: the extra's top: this fraction of the head or torso's height plus this fraction of its own

name.description: its bone's name (a second one gets 2, and so on)

bake.description: the baker's settings, the same for every form

box.description: the stage box every Billie fits in, its middle and ground line (pixels)

margin.description: pixels kept clear of the box's edges

pad.description: room round a torso for its squash and stretch frames (pixels)

squash.description: the torso's frames, each [x scale, y scale]; main is the torso at rest

tailAim.description: where a tail part points from the front: degrees, 0 = out to the right, 90 = up; a tail not here sits centred on the torso's tail socket

tailBackSweep.description: from behind, a tail turns this much of its aim

armOut.description: how far an arm's far end hangs out from straight down (degrees)

footGap.description: how far apart the feet stand at least, as their width

chinDrop.description: the chin sits this much of the head's height below the neck socket

anchors.description: where an extra hangs: brow (horns), ears, crown (on top of the head), chin (a beard), back (carried on the back), collar (round the neck, at the torso's neck socket)

line.description: the line (game/data/lines) whose stage it is

scale.description: its stage scale (shrunk by the baker if the Billie does not fit the box)

parts.description: a kit part per bone kind: [part id (partKits.json), size, colour]; head and torso are needed

extras.description: each [part id, anchor, size, colour, a mirrored pair, the slot it fills (optional)]

slots.description: the slot a bone kind fills, in place of its usual one (rules.json parts.slots)

armOut.description: how far its arms hang out (degrees), in place of bake.armOut
